[[Category:Dungeons]]
[[sn:Totem Library]]In the heart of a verdant, coastal woodland realm echoing with the echoes of ancestral tales, the Totem Library dungeon beckons players to navigate its intricate totemic mysteries. Drawing inspiration from the Haida Gwaii archipelago, this dungeon presents challenges that require an understanding of both nature and ancestral culture, all while dealing with the illusions cast by the nefarious Absurdist.

== Background ==
The Totem Library was once a peaceful confluence of nature and ancestral teachings, shaped and protected by its guardian spirit, The Raven. This transformative symbol of knowledge and change crafted a land rich in Gwaiian lore, where every tree and stone whispered tales of ages gone by. However, as colonial forces encroached, distorting the narratives and imposing their versions of reality, the sacred groves became an arena of conflict between preservation and erasure.

== Location ==
The Totem Library is located within the stunning landscapes of a coastal woodland, reminiscent of the [[Haida Gwaii]] archipelago. The region reflects a harmonious blend of natural beauty and cultural heritage.

== Aspect ==
At its core, the Totem Library embodies Enlensing (Absurdity Vaccine), which challenges perceptions, making players question and alter their understanding of the environment around them.

== Dungeon Item ==
Once players overcome the [[Totem Spirit Guardians]], they acquire [[The Perspective Prism]]. This multifaceted lens refracts reality, changing one's perception of the environment, allowing for interaction with objects and stories that were previously hidden from view.

== Key Object ==
The [[Totem Shard]] is an integral piece of an ancient totem pole. With the Perspective Prism, players can unveil a narrative that provides clues to navigate the Gwaiian Expanse.

== Midboss ==
The [[Totem Spirit Guardians]] represent past Gwaiian guardians trapped in an eternal, absurd dance. Players must aid these spirits by reshaping their perceptions and restoring their lost purpose.

== Boss ==
The main adversary, [[The Absurdist]], is a colonial marauder determined to erase the ancestral value of the land. Through illusions and historical distortions, he obscures the true narrative, making it challenging for players to distinguish reality from fiction.

== Dungeon Description ==
The Gwaiian Expanse is a land where time stands still, and ancestral tales come alive. Players will harness the power of the Perspective Prism to navigate the labyrinthine woodland, interacting with enigmatic totem poles and decoding the stories carved onto them. Throughout this journey, [[The Raven]] serves as a guide, steering adventurers clear of the Absurdist's misleading tales.

== Surrounding Location ==
The [[Totem Groves]], dense woods encircling the main dungeon, house many totem poles, each a repository of ancient tales. Protected by the land's spirits, secrets await the worthy, promising rewards and insights.

== Guardian Spirit ==
[[The Raven]], an emblem of transformation, knowledge, and change, serves as the guiding light in this mystical realm. This guardian shares tales and wisdom, ensuring that the Gwaiian heritage remains untarnished.

== Exploration of Theme ==
The Totem Library delves into the tension between preserving ancestral legacies and the external forces trying to rewrite or erase them. It emphasizes the vital importance of understanding, respect, and conservation.
*** '''Enhancements:'''
*** Learning and mastering Gwaiian crafts aids in puzzle-solving and progression.
*** Assisting spirits in reclaiming their narratives bolsters the theme of cultural memory.
*** Time-shifting segments offer a firsthand experience of Gwaiian ancestral stories.
*** Interaction with Gwaiian inhabitants enhances the cultural immersion, with ceremonies and traditions serving as challenges or mini-games.
*** Gwaiian myths come alive as woodland creatures, each manifesting the dungeon's core themes, aiding or obstructing players' quests.

The journey through the Totem Library offers a unique gameplay experience, deepening players' understanding of indigenous cultures, their rich narratives, and the challenges of preserving such legacies in the face of external adversities.
